title: 2026最狠清网行动：VPN大面积关停，未来将面临怎样的“大断网”？20260508【新闻大写】
executive_summary: The video discusses the ongoing battle between China's Great Firewall (GFW) and VPNs, with a focus on the 2026 'clean net' action and its implications for internet freedom in China.

key_facts: China's Great Firewall (GFW) has been in operation since 1998 as part of the Golden Shield Project.
The GFW uses various techniques to block access to foreign websites, including IP blocking, DNS pollution, and deep packet inspection (DPI).
Despite the GFW, there are ongoing efforts to circumvent it, including the development of new VPN protocols and tools.
The Chinese government has been tightening control over the internet, with a major overhaul of the Network Security Law in 2026.
There have been significant leaks of internal documents related to China's internet censorship efforts, including a 572GB leak in 2025.
forward_implications: The ongoing battle between China's GFW and VPNs is likely to continue, with implications for internet freedom and access to information in China.
The Chinese government's efforts to tighten control over the internet may lead to increased restrictions on online activity and more severe penalties for those who circumvent the GFW.
The development of new VPN protocols and tools is likely to continue, as individuals and organizations seek to maintain access to foreign websites and information.
